description: This file defines the 'Policy' class within an Android device administration context. It manages device policy settings such as password quality and minimum length, handles preferences storage, and interacts with Android's DevicePolicyManager. It also contains an inner class 'PolicyAdmin' for device admin receiver callbacks.

classes.name: Policy
classes.description: Manages device password policies and device administrator status for an Android device.

classes.name: Policy.PolicyAdmin
classes.description: Android device administrator receiver callback class for handling admin events like disablement.

methods.name: saveToLocal
methods.description: Saves specified password policy parameters to shared preferences.

methods.name: readFromLocal
methods.description: Reads password policy parameters from shared preferences.

methods.name: getPasswordQuality
methods.description: Returns the current password quality setting.

methods.name: getPasswordLength
methods.description: Returns the current minimum password length.

methods.name: getPasswordMinUpperCase
methods.description: Returns the current minimum uppercase letter requirement.

methods.name: getPolicyAdmin
methods.description: Returns the ComponentName for the device admin component.

methods.name: isAdminActive
methods.description: Checks whether the device admin is currently active.

methods.name: isActivePasswordSufficient
methods.description: Checks whether the active password meets the device's security policy.

methods.name: isDeviceSecured
methods.description: Determines if the device has active admin and a sufficient password.

methods.name: configurePolicy
methods.description: Applies the saved password policies via DevicePolicyManager.
